title: Chu kỳ
emptyDescription: A chu kỳ is a time-boxed period the team plans its issues into.
nothingPlannedDescription: The timeline shows active and upcoming chu kỳ. Finished ones are in the table.

transfer.title: Move unfinished issues
transfer.description: Unfinished issues move to the chu kỳ you pick. Finished and canceled ones stay here.
transfer.moved: {count, plural, one {# issue moved} other {# issues moved}}

finish.title: Finish chu kỳ early
finish.description: {cycle} closes today instead of {date}. You can't reopen it. {count, plural, =0 {Nothing is left unfinished.} one {# unfinished issue stays on it.} other {# unfinished issues stay on it.}}

startNext.title: Start the next chu kỳ today
startNext.description: {cycle} closes today and you can't reopen it. {next} starts today and still ends on {date}. {count, plural, =0 {Nothing carries over.} one {# unfinished issue moves to it.} other {# unfinished issues move to it.}} Finished and canceled issues stay on {cycle}.
startNext.started: {cycle} started. {count, plural, =0 {No issues carried over.} one {# issue carried over.} other {# issues carried over.}}

delete.title: Xóa chu kỳ
delete.description: {cycle} is deleted for good. {count, plural, =0 {It holds no issues.} one {# issue stays in the project, without a cycle.} other {# issues stay in the project, without a cycle.}}

dragFailed: Could not move the chu kỳ
